name: Northwest Youth Corps Youth Urban and Community Forestry Crews (Eugene)
what_you_do: A 5 week day program. Crews of 8 youth and 2 adult leaders work on tree projects in city parks, public land and community gardens. They also get about 8 hours a week of training.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18 in the Eugene area. Teens commute to a central meeting place each day; local housing is not provided.
pay_detail: Stipend of $96 a day (up to $480 a week) plus $20 dependability and $20 safety weekly bonuses. Tuition fee $200, with need-based assistance.
duration: 5 weeks, Monday to Friday, about 32 work hours a week (2026 Oregon: June 15 to July 17 or July 21 to Aug 21)
deadline_text: 2026 dates are posted. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Eugene Apply link on the program page (Northwest Youth Corps application site). Contact info@nwyouthcorps.org.
notes: Possible high school credit (ask your counselor). Same program also runs in Boise and Tacoma. Dates may change. NYC is based in Eugene. Oregon BOLI says minors age 14 to 17 are not issued individual work permits in Oregon (employers need a certificate to employ minors). A sibling card for the Tacoma crew uses the youth-ucf page; this card uses the program guide so the urls differ.
